note: Out-of-CORPUS, not out-of-domain. MSMARCO is broad web QA, so the honest negative set is questions whose answers are absent from the 60k passages we actually indexed: local, personal, time-bound, or about the system itself. These drive the relevance-threshold sweep in guardrails/calibrate.py.
